think_procedure: Identify the knob’s type and normal operating range/order (e.g., integer with increasing effect).
Check whether the knob defines one or more sentinel numeric values (commonly 0 or -1) that switch the behavior to a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/auto).
If such a sentinel exists, mark it as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise mark it as not special.
